root_cause: The CPU functional test smoke_Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul_TransposeInput/Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmulTest.Inference failed numerical comparison on ARM64 with i4 weights (all 128 output elements are wrong). The PR (#36745) only changes the AUTO plugin and IPF third-party library and does not touch the CPU Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul transformation. This is a pre-existing or environment-specific accuracy issue in the ARM64 CPU backend for the Conv1x1-to-MatMul transformation with i4 compressed weights and Transpose input/output.
reproduction_steps: Build OpenVINO for ARM64 and run: ./ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul_TransposeInput*wPrec=i4*
recommended_actions: Investigate whether this test consistently fails on ARM64 for the Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul transformation with i4 weights independently of this PR.
Check if the test was already failing on master before PR #36745 was enqueued.
If pre-existing, disable/track the failing test separately and re-queue PR #36745.
If regression caused by this PR, investigate how AUTO plugin or IPF changes could indirectly affect CPU plugin numerical behavior (unlikely but worth checking).
prevention_strategies: Ensure ARM64 CPU functional tests run on PRs that introduce new transformations or weight-compression logic. Add explicit ARM64 CI coverage for Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul test class.
